spec.title: required: one line that says what the animation shows
spec.width: 5000 must be between 16 and 2000
spec.background: "red" must be a hex colour, such as #0969da, or "none"
spec.shapes[0].w: required
spec.shapes[0].h: required
spec.shapes[1].id: "a" is already the id of spec.shapes[0]
spec.shapes[2].id: "1bad" must start with a letter and hold only letters, digits, - and _
spec.shapes[2].type: "blob" is not one of rect, circle, line, text, path
spec.shapes[2].w: required
spec.shapes[2].h: required
spec.shapes[3].fill: "#000;stroke=red" must be a hex colour, such as #0969da, or "none"
spec.shapes[4].d: must be SVG path data that starts with M, such as "M 10 10 L 90 10"
spec.shapes[5]: a line with no stroke and no fill cannot be seen; give it a stroke
spec.steps[0].targets[0]: no shape has the id "nobody"
spec.steps[1].to: unknown key "colour"; a step can change x, y, scale, rotate, opacity, draw
spec.steps[1].to.draw: "label" is a text, and a text cannot be drawn on
spec.steps[2].to.opacity: 4 must be between 0 and 1
spec.steps[2].ease: "wobble" is not one of linear, inQuad, outQuad, inOutQuad, inCubic, outCubic, inOutCubic, inQuart, outQuart, inOutQuart, inSine, outSine, inOutSine, inExpo, outExpo, inOutExpo, inCirc, outCirc, inOutCirc, inBack, outBack, inOutBack, inElastic, outElastic, inOutElastic, inBounce, outBounce, inOutBounce
spec.steps[3]: ends at 24000ms; an animation can be at most 20000ms long
